Linear Integrated Circuits: Operational Amplifiers (Op-Amps), Linear & Non-linear applications, Voltage regulators, 555 Timers, Phase Locked Loops (PLL)
Microprocessors & Microcontrollers: Architecture and programming of 8085 Microprocessor, Assembly language, Peripherals & Interfacing, Microcontrollers
Electronic Measurements: Measuring systems, Range extension, Cathode Ray Oscilloscope (CRO), LCD/LED display panels, Transducers & Sensors

Communication Engineering: Modulation & Demodulation techniques, Multiplexing (TDM/FDM), Wave propagation, Transmission lines, Optical Fiber Communication (OFC), Radar, Satellite & Cellular Communication
Data Communication & Networks: Hardware interfaces, LAN, WAN, Network devices, OSI & TCP/IP models, Internetworking
Computer Programming: Programming concepts in C and C++, Control statements, Functions, Arrays, Pointers, Structures, File Handling, Data Structures, DBMS
Basic Electrical Engineering: DC/AC Circuits, Magnetic/Thermal/Chemical effects of electric current, Earthing, Maintenance & Testing

syllabus.section: 10. Technical Abilities: Mechanical & Allied Engineering Exam Group (Annexure VIII-D)
topics: Engineering Mechanics: Resolution of forces, Equilibrium, Lami's theorem, Friction, Limiting angle, Moment of Inertia, Radius of gyration (I/T/L/Z sections), Newton's laws, Projectile motion, Work-Energy-Power

Strength of Materials: Stress-Strain, Factor of Safety, Thermal stresses, Strain energy, SFD & BMD (Cantilever, Simply Supported, Continuous beams), Torsion in shafts, Springs, Thin cylinders

Machining & Machine Tools: Lathe construction, Tool signature, Cutting angles, Turning, Facing, Thread cutting, Knurling, Drilling, Boring, Shaper, Slotter, Planer, Milling, Broaching, Gear manufacturing, Cutting fluids & Coolants
Welding Technology: Arc welding, Gas welding (Oxy-acetylene), Electrodes, Soldering, Brazing, Modern welding (MIG, TIG, Submerged Arc, CO2, Ultrasonic welding), Welding defects & inspection

Grinding & Finishing: Abrasives (Natural/Artificial), Bonds, Grinding machines (Surface, Cylindrical, Tool & Cutter, Centreless), Wheel balancing, Honing, Lapping, Super-finishing, Electroplating, Metal spraying, Powder coating

Metrology & Precision Gauges: Slip gauges, Dial indicators, Bevel protractor, Sine bar, Comparators (Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, Pneumatic), Surface roughness measurement, Interferometry, Optical profile projectors

Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery: Fluid properties, Pressure measurement, Buoyancy, Bernoulli's theorem, Venturimeter, Pitot tube, Centrifugal pumps (Efficiencies, Cavitation), Jet & Submersible pumps

Industrial Management: Production planning & control, Routing, Scheduling, Dispatching, PERT/CPM, Inventory control, ABC analysis, Safety stock, EOQ, Stores layout, Material handling (Cranes, Hoists, Forklifts)

Thermal Engineering & Power Plants: Laws of Thermodynamics, Thermodynamic processes (Isochoric, Isobaric, Isothermal, Isentropic, Polytropic), Heat transfer (Conduction, Convection, Radiation, Stefan-Boltzmann law), Air standard cycles (Carnot, Otto, Diesel), IC Engines (2-Stroke/4-Stroke, Performance testing), Air Compressors & Refrigeration systems

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official unified Railway Recruitment Boards application portal at https://rrbapply.gov.in.

Step 2: If applying for the first time, click on 'Create an Account' and complete Aadhaar / DigiLocker verification (candidates with existing RRB accounts must use existing credentials). Note: Details entered in 'Create an Account' and 'Chosen RRB' CANNOT be changed later.
Step 3: Select only ONE Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) and fill in educational qualifications, trade/engineering stream, community, and address details.
Step 4: Exercise your order of preference for Railway Zones/Production Units and notified posts within the chosen RRB.
Step 5: Capture a LIVE Photograph using the web camera or mobile front camera following strict parameters (dark clothing, eye level, neutral expression, plain background, no caps/spectacles/masks).
Step 6: Upload scanned signature in JPG/JPEG format (30 to 49 KB, black ink pen on white paper, running cursive handwriting, dimensions min 140x60 pixels, scan box 35x20 mm).
Step 7: Upload SC/ST certificate in PDF format (<400 KB) if opting for Free Railway Travel Pass.
Step 8: Pay the application fee (₹500 for UR/OBC/EWS Male, ₹250 for SC/ST/PwBD/ExSM/Female/EBC) online via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI before 15.09.2026 (23:59 Hrs).
Step 9: Review the complete application preview, verify all declarations, submit the form, and save the final Registration Slip / PDF for Document Verification.

importantInstructions: SINGLE APPLICATION TO ONE RRB ONLY: Candidates can apply to only ONE RRB and submit only ONE online application. Submitting multiple applications to different RRBs or the same RRB will lead to summary rejection of all applications and LIFETIME DEBARMENT from RRB/RRC examinations.
STRICT CLOSING DATE FOR QUALIFICATIONS: Candidates must possess the prescribed educational/technical qualifications on or before 13.09.2026. Awaiting final year results makes candidates INELIGIBLE.

LIVE PHOTO MANDATE: Pre-existing printed/digital photos are strictly prohibited. The system captures a live webcam/mobile image. Wear dark clothing; avoid white clothes, caps, masks, and spectacles. Appearance throughout recruitment must match the live photo.

SIGNATURE REJECTION RULES: Signatures must be in running handwriting using black ink. Signatures in BLOCK / CAPITAL / DISJOINTED letters, initials, or thumb impressions in place of signature will lead to immediate rejection.
VIRTUAL CALCULATOR IN CBT-II: An on-screen virtual calculator will be provided on the computer monitor during 2nd Stage CBT. Physical calculators and electronic devices are strictly banned.
NEGATIVE MARKING @ 1/3rd: For every incorrect answer, 1/3rd (0.33) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted in both CBT-I and CBT-II.

LASIK SURGERY RESTRICTION: Candidates who have undergone Lasik surgery or refractive surgery are STRICTLY INELIGIBLE for posts requiring Medical Standard A-3. For B-1 posts, Lasik is permitted only if performed >= 1 year ago with corneal thickness >= 425 microns.
SERVICE BOND & TRAINING: Selected candidates must undergo prescribed training with stipend only. Appointees must execute a Security and/or Indemnity Bond upon joining.
TRANSFER RESTRICTIONS: Newly appointed Railway servants cannot register any transfer request to another Railway before completing at least 5 to 10 years of regular service.
MODIFICATION WINDOW: Modifications (except Create an Account details & chosen RRB) allowed from 16.09.2026 to 25.09.2026 upon paying ₹250 non-refundable fee per occasion.

faqs.question: What is the official notice number and date for RRB JE Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The official recruitment notice is Detailed Centralised Employment Notice CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS), published by Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways.

faqs.question: How many total vacancies are advertised in RRB CEN 04/2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 3,993 vacancies are advertised across 21 Railway Recruitment Boards, 17 Zonal Railways, and 5 Production Units for Junior Engineer (JE) and Depot Material Superintendent (DMS) posts.

faqs.question: What is the category-wise vacancy distribution for RRB JE CEN 04/2026?
faqs.answer: The vacancies are distributed as: Unreserved (UR): 1,699, Other Backward Classes (OBC-NCL): 913, Scheduled Castes (SC): 624, Economically Weaker Sections (EWS): 394, Scheduled Tribes (ST): 363. Horizontal quotas include Ex-Servicemen: 387 and PwBD: 193 (LD: 135, HI: 47, MD: 11).

faqs.question: What are the starting and closing dates for RRB JE 2026 online applications?
faqs.answer: Online application registration opens on 14th August 2026 and closes on 13th September 2026 at 23:59 Hours on https://rrbapply.gov.in.

faqs.question: What is the Pay Level and monthly salary for RRB Junior Engineer?
faqs.answer: The post carries 7th CPC Pay Level 6 with a starting Basic Pay of ₹35,400/- per month. Including DA, HRA, and Transport Allowance, total gross starting salary ranges between ₹55,000/- to ₹65,000/- per month.

faqs.question: What are the educational qualifications required for RRB Junior Engineer?
faqs.answer: Candidates must hold a 3-Year Diploma in Engineering or B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc (Engineering) in relevant branches (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, CS, IT, Instrumentation, Automobile, Production, etc.) from a recognized University/Institute.

faqs.question: What qualification is required for Depot Material Superintendent (DMS)?
faqs.answer: Candidates must hold a 3-Year Diploma in Engineering in ANY discipline OR B.E. / B.Tech in ANY engineering branch from a recognized University / Institution.

faqs.question: Are final year engineering students eligible to apply for RRB JE 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification on or before the closing date of application (13th September 2026). Those awaiting results are NOT eligible.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for RRB JE & DMS recruitment as on 01.01.2027?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 18 to 33 years of age as on 01.01.2027 (Born between 02.01.1994 and 01.01.2009 for UR/EWS).

faqs.question: What age relaxation is available for reserved categories?
faqs.answer: Upper age relaxation is: SC/ST candidates: 5 years (up to 38 yrs), OBC-NCL candidates: 3 years (up to 36 yrs), PwBD (UR/EWS): 10 years (up to 43 yrs), PwBD (OBC): 13 years, PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years, Ex-Servicemen: Military service + 3 to 8 years.

faqs.question: Can I apply to more than one RRB for CEN 04/2026?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates can select and apply to only ONE RRB. Submitting multiple applications to different RRBs or the same RRB will result in rejection of all applications and lifetime debarment from RRB/RRC examinations.

faqs.question: What is the application fee and how much is refunded?
faqs.answer: For UR, OBC, and EWS Male candidates, the fee is ₹500/-, out of which ₹400/- is refunded after attending CBT-I. For SC, ST, ExSM, PwBD, Female, Transgender, Minorities, and EBC candidates, the fee is ₹250/-, with 100% (₹250/-) refunded upon appearing in CBT-I.

faqs.question: How will the exam fee refund be processed?
faqs.answer: Fee refunds will be automatically credited to the candidate's Aadhaar-seeded bank account validated via the NPCI portal during the online application process.

faqs.question: What is the recruitment selection process for RRB JE 2026?
faqs.answer: The selection comprises: 1) 1st Stage CBT (Screening, 100 MCQs), 2) 2nd Stage CBT (Core Technical + General, 150 MCQs), 3) Document Verification (1:1 ratio based on CBT-II Merit Index), and 4) Medical Examination.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern for RRB JE 1st Stage CBT?
faqs.answer: 1st Stage CBT has 100 MCQs in 90 minutes (120 mins for scribe): Mathematics (30 Qs), General Intelligence & Reasoning (25 Qs), General Awareness (15 Qs), and General Science (30 Qs). Negative marking is 1/3rd mark.

faqs.question: How many candidates are shortlisted from CBT-I for CBT-II?
faqs.answer: Candidates equal to 15 times the community-wise vacancy of posts notified against the chosen RRB will be shortlisted for 2nd Stage CBT based on CBT-I normalized scores.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern for RRB JE 2nd Stage CBT?
faqs.answer: 2nd Stage CBT has 150 MCQs in 120 minutes: General Awareness (15 Qs), Physics & Chemistry (15 Qs), Computer Applications (10 Qs), Environment & Pollution Control (10 Qs), and Technical Abilities of chosen Exam Group (100 Qs). Negative marking is 1/3rd mark.

faqs.question: Is a virtual calculator provided in RRB JE CBT-II?
faqs.answer: Yes. An on-screen Virtual Calculator will be made available on the computer monitor during the 2nd Stage CBT.

faqs.question: What are the four Exam Groups for CBT-II Technical Abilities?
faqs.answer: The 4 Exam Groups are: 1) Civil & Allied Engineering, 2) Electrical & Allied Engineering, 3) Electronics & Allied Engineering, and 4) Mechanical & Allied Engineering.

faqs.question: How is the Merit Index calculated for inter-discipline ranking?
faqs.answer: Merit Index is calculated as: Sq + (St - Sq) * [(M - Mq) / (Mt - Mq)], where Sq=350, St=900, Mq=40 (qualifying mark for UR), and Mt=Mean marks of top 0.1% candidates.

faqs.question: What are the minimum qualifying marks in CBT-I and CBT-II?
faqs.answer: UR: 40%, EWS: 40%, OBC-NCL: 30%, SC: 30%, ST: 25%. A 2-mark relaxation is allowed for PwBD candidates in case of shortage.

faqs.question: Are candidates with LASIK surgery eligible for RRB JE posts?
faqs.answer: Candidates with LASIK surgery are STRICTLY INELIGIBLE for Medical Standard A-3 posts. For B-1 posts, Lasik is allowed only if surgery was done >=1 year ago with corneal thickness >=425 microns and normal fundus.

faqs.question: What are the requirements for Live Photo Capturing?
faqs.answer: Candidates must capture a live photo via webcam/front camera wearing dark clothing, facing straight with a neutral expression, without cap, mask, or spectacles. Pre-existing photos are not accepted.

faqs.question: What are the specifications for uploading signature?
faqs.answer: Signature must be in running cursive handwriting using a black ink pen on white paper, scanned at min 100 DPI, JPG format, file size 30 to 49 KB, dimensions min 140x60 pixels. Signatures in BLOCK/CAPITAL letters will be rejected.

faqs.question: What is the validity period for OBC-NCL and EWS certificates?
faqs.answer: OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 up to 13.09.2026 for Financial Year 2026-27 based on FY 2025-26 income in the prescribed Central Govt format.

faqs.question: When can candidates modify their submitted application form?
faqs.answer: The application modification window will be open from 16th September 2026 to 25th September 2026 upon payment of a non-refundable modification fee of ₹250/- per occasion. 'Create an Account' details and 'Chosen RRB' cannot be modified.

faqs.question: Is there a Free Train Travel facility for SC and ST candidates?
faqs.answer: Yes. SC and ST candidates who opt for free travel and upload a valid caste certificate in PDF (<400 KB) will receive a Free Sleeper Class Railway Travel Pass with their e-call letter.

faqs.question: What is the procedure for engaging a Scribe for PwBD candidates?
faqs.answer: Scribes must register on rrbapply.gov.in to obtain an OTR number. Scribe-eligible candidates must enter the scribe's OTR number during the scribe entry window from 26.09.2026 to 30.09.2026 and verify via OTP. Scribe educational qualification must be one step below the candidate.

faqs.question: Is there any service bond for appointed Junior Engineers in Railways?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must execute a Security and/or Indemnity Bond at the time of joining as prescribed by the respective Zonal Railway / Production Unit.

faqs.question: Can newly appointed Junior Engineers request inter-railway transfer?
faqs.answer: No transfer request to another Railway or establishment will be registered until the newly appointed candidate completes at least 5 to 10 years of regular service.

faqs.question: Which RRB has the highest number of vacancies in CEN 04/2026?
faqs.answer: RRB Kolkata has the highest vacancies with 457 posts (CLW, ER, SER, Metro), followed by RRB Mumbai with 411 posts (CR, WR), and RRB Chennai with 362 posts (ICF, SR).

faqs.question: What happens if a candidate fails the medical fitness test after DV?
faqs.answer: Candidates failing to qualify in the prescribed medical fitness standard for the opted post will not be empanelled and NO alternative appointment will be offered by Railways.

faqs.question: What languages are available for RRB JE CBT examination?
faqs.answer: Questions will be available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional Indian languages: Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu.

faqs.question: Where can candidates download the official CEN 04/2026 notification PDF?
faqs.answer: The official detailed notification PDF can be downloaded from the official websites of any of the 21 Railway Recruitment Boards or directly from https://rrbapply.gov.in.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for Bank of Baroda LBO Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The online application portal opens on 18 August 2026 and closes on 07 September 2026. Candidates must register and pay the fee before 07 September 2026.

faqs.question: How many total vacancies are released in BOB Local Bank Officer recruitment?
faqs.answer: A total of 2,482 vacancies are released across 20 States in India. Top states include Gujarat (1,185), Karnataka (418), Maharashtra (218), Tamil Nadu (132), and Odisha (100).

faqs.question: What is the pay scale and experience increment for BOB LBOs?
faqs.answer: BOB LBOs are appointed in Junior Management Grade Scale-I (JMG/S-I) with a pay scale of ₹48,480 - ₹85,920. Selected candidates with 1+ year officer banking experience will receive 1 advance increment upon joining, along with DA, HRA, CCA, and bank perquisites.

faqs.question: What is the 12-Year Home State posting rule in BOB LBO?
faqs.answer: Selected Local Bank Officers are guaranteed posting within the State they applied for during the first 12 years of their active service or until their promotion to SMGS-IV Grade (Chief Manager), whichever is earlier.

faqs.question: What is the mandatory eligibility criteria regarding work experience?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and minimum 1 year of post-qualification executive experience as an Officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank listed in RBI's Second Schedule as on 01.08.2026. Clerical experience is not eligible.

faqs.question: Is the English Language section counted in the final merit list?
faqs.answer: No. The English Language section (30 Questions / 30 Marks) is qualifying in nature only. Marks scored in English will NOT be added to determine the final merit rank.

faqs.question: What is the service bond requirement for BOB LBO?
faqs.answer: Selected candidates must execute a service bond to serve the bank for a minimum of 3 years, or pay 3 months' gross salary (subject to a maximum of ₹2,00,000) if they resign before completing 3 years of active service.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for Bank of Baroda LBO 2026?
faqs.answer: General, EWS, and OBC candidates must pay ₹850 (inclusive of GST) plus payment gateway charges. SC, ST, PwBD, ESM, and all Women candidates pay ₹175 intimation charges plus gateway charges.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for IOCL Executive CBT Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The online application opened on 14 August 2026 and closes on 03 September 2026 at 17:00 Hrs. The online CBT will be held on 24 September 2026, with admit cards available on 15 September 2026.

faqs.question: What are the pay scales and CTC packages offered by IOCL for Executive posts?
faqs.answer: Grade ‘A’ (Graduate Engineers, Marketing, Law): ₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000 (Approx CTC ₹18.4 Lakhs/yr); Grade ‘A0’ (Assistant Quality Control Officer): ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000 (Approx CTC ₹14.8 Lakhs/yr); Grade ‘E0’ (Diploma Engineers): ₹30,000 – ₹1,20,000 (Approx CTC ₹11.1 Lakhs/yr).

faqs.question: What is the selection process and merit weightage in IOCL 2026 recruitment?

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and duration for IOCL CBT 2026?
faqs.answer: The CBT has 100 MCQs (150 minutes total duration): Section A has 50 Questions (Quant 20, Reasoning 15, English 15) for 60 minutes; Section B has 50 Domain Knowledge Questions for 90 minutes. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.

faqs.question: Can B.Tech / Engineering degree holders apply for Diploma Engineer (Grade E0) posts?

faqs.question: How many examination test cities are available for the online CBT?
faqs.answer: The online CBT will be conducted across 83 major cities pan-India spanning all States and Union Territories. Candidates can choose up to 3 preferred test centers during application.

faqs.question: What is the service bond amount for IOCL Executive recruitment?

faqs.question: What is the application fee for IOCL Executive positions?
faqs.answer: General, EWS, and OBC (NCL) candidates must pay ₹1,000 plus applicable GST. SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are 100% exempted from paying the application fee.

selectionProcess.description: Objective type multiple choice questions exam conducted in two parts on the same day: Part-A is a 10th standard Punjabi Language qualifying test (minimum 50% marks compulsory to qualify). Part-B is the core competitive exam covering General Knowledge, Reasoning, Numerical Ability, English, Punjabi, and Computer Awareness. 1 Mark per question with 0.25 (1/4th) negative marking for each incorrect answer. Merit is determined purely on Part-B marks.

Shortlisted candidates based on written exam Part-B merit will be called for a Computer Typing Test. Candidates must achieve a minimum typing speed of 30 Words Per Minute (WPM) in both English and Punjabi. Punjabi typing will be strictly conducted using the Unicode Compliant Font Raavi. Typing test is mandatory and of Qualifying Nature.

Candidates who qualify the typing test will be summoned for counselling and scrutiny of original certificates (Matric Punjabi mark sheet, Degree certificate, 120-Hr ISO 9001 Computer / O-Level certificate, Punjab Domicile Certificate issued within 5 years, Caste/EWS/ESM/PwD certificates).

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies announced in PSSSB Advt 02/2026 Corrigendum?
faqs.answer: PSSSB has confirmed a total of 531 vacancies for Clerk (Common Cadre) Group-C distributed across 29 Punjab Government Departments, Boards, and District Commissioner Offices.

faqs.question: What are the reopening application dates for PSSSB Clerk 531 Vacancies?
faqs.answer: Online applications are reopened on the PSSSB portal from 25 August 2026 and will remain open until 07 September 2026 (5:00 PM). The last date to pay the application fee is also 07 September 2026.

faqs.question: I already applied for Advt. No. 02/2026 in February/March 2026. Do I need to apply again?
faqs.answer: No. As clearly stated in paragraph 3.0 of the Corrigendum, candidates who have already applied under Advertisement No. 02/2026 earlier do NOT need to re-apply. Their earlier applications remain 100% valid.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for PSSSB Clerk recruitment?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor degree in any discipline from a recognized university, must have completed at least a 120-hour computer course (or DOEACC O Level), and must have passed Matriculation (10th) with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject.

faqs.question: Is the 120-hour computer course mandatory? What institutions are valid?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates must possess at least 120 hours course with working experience in Personal Computers / IT in Office Productivity or Desktop Publishing Applications from a Government recognized or ISO 9001 certified institution, OR a DOEACC O Level certificate.

faqs.question: What font is used for the PSSSB Punjabi typing test?
faqs.answer: The Punjabi computer typing test will be strictly conducted using the Unicode Compliant Font Raavi at a speed of 30 words per minute (WPM).

faqs.question: What is the typing speed requirement for English and Punjabi?
faqs.answer: Candidates must achieve a minimum typing speed of 30 WPM in both English and Punjabi on computer. Both typing tests are qualifying in nature.

faqs.question: What is the examination pattern and marking scheme for PSSSB Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: The exam consists of two parts: Part-A is a 10th-standard Punjabi Language qualifying paper (50% marks compulsory). Part-B is the competitive merit paper consisting of objective MCQs. Each question carries 1 mark with 0.25 (1/4th) negative marking for incorrect answers.

faqs.question: What happens if a candidate fails to score 50% in Part-A (Punjabi Language)?
faqs.answer: Securing at least 50% marks in Part-A Punjabi Language test is mandatory. Failure to score 50% in Part-A will disqualify the candidate immediately from the merit list, regardless of high marks obtained in Part-B.

faqs.question: What is the salary / pay scale for PSSSB Clerk Common Cadre?
faqs.answer: The post falls under Punjab 7th CPC Matrix Level-2. Selected candidates receive a fixed initial basic pay of Rs. 19,900/- per month during the 3-year probation period, followed by regular full allowances upon confirmation.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for PSSSB Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: As on 01.01.2026, the age limit is 18 to 37 years for General candidates, 18 to 42 years for SC/BC of Punjab, 18 to 45 years for Govt employees, and 18 to 47 years for Divyangjan (PwD) of Punjab.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for PSSSB Clerk recruitment?
faqs.answer: General / Sports / Freedom Fighters: Rs. 1,000/-; SC / BC / EWS of Punjab: Rs. 250/-; Ex-Servicemen & Dependents: Rs. 200/-; Physically Handicapped (PwD): Rs. 500/-.

faqs.question: Can candidates from other states apply for PSSSB Clerk?
faqs.answer: Candidates from other states can apply under the General/Unreserved category provided they have passed Matriculation (10th) with Punjabi as a compulsory/elective subject and fulfill all qualification criteria. Reservation benefits are strictly restricted to Punjab domicile holders.

faqs.question: Is Punjab Domicile / Residence Certificate compulsory for reserved category candidates?
faqs.answer: Yes. All candidates claiming reservation (SC, BC, EWS, ESM, Sports, PwD, FF) must produce a valid Punjab Domicile / Residence Certificate that is not more than 5 years old at the time of counselling.

faqs.question: Which departments have the highest number of vacancies in this recruitment?
faqs.answer: The highest vacancies are in Excise & Taxation Department (150 posts: 145 Field + 5 Head Office), Punjab State Agricultural Marketing Board / Mandi Board (90 posts), DC Gurdaspur (36 posts), Revenue & Disaster Management (25 posts), DC Barnala (24 posts), and DC Moga (21 posts).

faqs.question: How will the final merit list be prepared?
faqs.answer: The Common Merit List will be prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Part-B of the written examination among candidates who have qualified Part-A (minimum 50%) and passed the English and Punjabi computer typing test (30 WPM).

faqs.question: How will tie-breaker in written exam merit be resolved?
faqs.answer: If two or more candidates score equal marks in Part-B, the candidate older in age will be placed higher. If age is identical, higher percentage in graduation degree, followed by higher marks in Matriculation will be used.

faqs.question: Can I edit my application form after final submission?
faqs.answer: No. As per PSSSB guidelines, once the application form is submitted and fee is paid, no correction or modification is permitted under any circumstances.

faqs.question: How can I contact PSSSB helpdesk if I face technical issues during online application?
faqs.answer: You can email helpdesk.sssbpb@gmail.com or call office numbers 0172-2298000 (Ext. 5106/5107), 0172-2298083, or helpline numbers 99885-80229 / 9646932955 between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM on working days.

faqs.question: Where will the exam admit cards and typing test call letters be published?
faqs.answer: Admit cards for written test and typing test will be released exclusively on the official website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in. No hard copies will be sent by postal mail.

north-eastern-hill-university-nehu-shill.title: NEHU Shillong & Tura Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 107 Guest Faculty Posts Across 43 Departments
overview: North-Eastern Hill University (NEHU), a premier Central University located in Shillong, Meghalaya, has released an official employment notification (Advt No: F.No.8-2/Estt.II(B)/GL/Advertisement/2026-3 dated 19/08/2026) inviting online applications from eligible Indian nationals for the engagement of Guest Faculty.

A total of 107 Guest Faculty positions are available across 43 academic departments and disciplines under 8 Schools at both the Shillong Campus (79 positions) and Tura Campus (28 positions) for the upcoming academic semester.

Selected Guest Faculty will receive an honorarium of ₹1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum ceiling of ₹50,000/- per month as per University / UGC norms. Appointments are purely temporary for the current semester or until regular faculty joins, whichever is earlier.

Eligible candidates holding Master's Degree (min 55% marks) with UGC-NET / CSIR-NET / SLET / Ph.D. or relevant professional qualifications as per UGC / AICTE / CoA guidelines can apply online via the Samarth portal (https://nehut.samarth.edu.in/) on or before 31 August 2026.

education: 1. General UGC Disciplines (Arts, Commerce, Humanities, Education, Law, Social Sciences, Sciences, Languages, Journalism, Library Science):

• Master's Degree with a minimum of 55% marks (or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university.

• Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar test accredited by UGC (like SLET/SET), OR who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with UGC Regulations.
2. Engineering & Technology Disciplines (IT, Biomedical Engg, Nanotechnology, Computer Applications):
• B.E. / B.Tech / B.S. and M.E. / M.Tech / M.S. or Integrated M.Tech in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one of the degrees (as per AICTE regulations).
3. Architecture Discipline (6 Posts):
• Bachelor's Degree in Architecture or equivalent to B.Arch with minimum 60% marks and 3 years of relevant professional experience; OR

• Bachelor's Degree in Architecture or equivalent to B.Arch and Master's Degree in Architecture or in allied subjects of Architecture with minimum 60% marks at either level and 1 year of relevant professional experience; OR
• BE Civil Engineering and Master's in Structural Design.
4. Management & Tourism Disciplines:
• Master's Degree in Business Administration / PGDM / CA / ICWA / M.Com with First Class or equivalent + NET/SLET/Ph.D. as per AICTE/UGC guidelines.

Step 2: If a first-time user, complete the registration by entering your email ID, mobile number, and creating a secure password.
Step 3: Log in with your registered credentials and navigate to 'Advertisement for Recruitment of Guest Faculty' (Advt No: F.No.8-2/Estt.II(B)/GL/Advertisement/2026-3).
Step 4: Select your desired School, Department, Specialization, and Campus (Shillong or Tura).
Step 5: Fill in your personal details, educational qualifications (UG, PG, NET/SLET/Ph.D.), research publications, and professional experience.
Step 6: Upload scanned copies of required documents, passport-size photograph, signature, and category certificate (if applicable).
Step 7: Review the complete application form carefully and submit it before the closing deadline on 31 August 2026.
Step 8: Download and retain a printout of the submitted application form for Document Verification / Interview.

overview: Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), East Coast Railway (ECoR), Bhubaneswar has published a centralized employment notification (Notification No. ECoR/Pers/RRC/Act Apprentice/2026-27 dated 21/08/2026) for the engagement of Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for the training year 2026–2027.

A total of 1,599 training slots are notified across 25 designated technical and vocational trades in various workshops and divisions under the jurisdiction of East Coast Railway, including Carriage Repair Workshop (CRW) Mancheswar (250 slots), Khurda Road Division (773 slots), Sambalpur Division (262 slots), Rayagada Division (292 slots), and ECoR Zonal Headquarters at Bhubaneswar (22 slots).

Selection will be made purely on the basis of academic merit calculated from the aggregate percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation (Class 10th with minimum 50% marks). There is NO written test, computer-based exam, or personal interview. Furthermore, candidates completing Act Apprenticeship training (CCAA) in Railway establishments holding National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) will receive preference for up to 20% of vacancies in open market Railway Level-1 (Group-D, Pay Scale ₹18,000 – ₹56,900) recruitments.

Eligible Indian citizens with 10th Pass (min 50% aggregate) and ITI / NTC Certificate in the relevant trade (or 12th PCB for Medical Lab Technician) can submit their online application through the official RRC Bhubaneswar portal (www.rrcbbs.org.in) starting from 26 August 2026 (17:00 hrs) until the closing deadline on 15 September 2026 (17:00 hrs).

education: 1. General Educational Qualification (All Trades): Passed Matriculation (Class 10th) examination under 10+2 examination system with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks from a recognized Board.

2. Technical Qualification (ITI Trades): Must possess an ITI Certificate (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in the relevant designated trade affiliated to NCVT / SCVT, as per the Apprentices Act, 1961.

3. Medical Laboratory Technician (Pathology): 12th pass (under 10+2 system) with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) with a minimum of 50% marks in both 10th & 12th examinations. Mark sheets and passing certificates of both Class 10 and Class 12 (PCB) must be uploaded.
4. Secretarial Assistant & Stenographer: Must possess National Trade Certificate (NTC) approved by NCVT/SCVT in Stenography / Secretarial Assistant trade.

5. Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA): Must possess Broad Base Basic Training in Information Technology Sector under Centre of Excellence (CoE) scheme in repair & maintenance of computer hardware & peripherals OR networking + National Trade Certificate (NTC) approved by NCVT/SCVT.

6. Ineligibility Clause: Engineering graduates (B.E./B.Tech) and Diploma holders are NOT eligible under this notification. Applicants whose Class 10th or ITI results are awaited or who have failed in ITI are strictly ineligible.

howToPayFee: Fee must be paid online only through the integrated payment gateway on RRC/BBS portal (www.rrcbbs.org.in).

Transaction charges, if any, will be borne by the applicant.
Once payment is successfully completed, download and save the application form and payment receipt.
If the fee is deducted but application status is unconfirmed, click 'Verify Payment' to reconfirm the transaction status.

selectionProcess.description: The merit list for each unit/division will be prepared solely on the basis of aggregate percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation (Class 10th), subject to a minimum of 50% aggregate marks.

Marks in all subjects mentioned in the mark sheet (including optional, additional, and alternate subjects) will be reckoned for percentage calculation — 'best of five' calculation is strictly prohibited. CGPA must be converted to equivalent percentage.

In case two or more applicants secure identical marks, preference will be given to the older candidate by date of birth. If DOB is also identical, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier will be placed higher.
There will be NO written test, computer-based examination, or viva voce. Selection is 100% merit-based.
Candidates shortlisted based on trade-wise and community-wise merit will be called for Document Verification at Headquarters of East Coast Railway, Bhubaneswar.
Final engagement is subject to verification of original certificates and submission of Medical Fitness Certificate in Annexure 'F' issued by a Gazetted Doctor (Assistant Surgeon or above).

howToApplySteps: Step 1: Visit the official nodal website of Railway Recruitment Cell, Bhubaneswar: www.rrcbbs.org.in.
Step 2: Locate and click on 'Engagement of Act Apprentices over ECoR for the year 2026–27' (Notification No. ECoR/Pers/RRC/Act Apprentice/2026-27).
Step 3: Register by providing your active email ID, mobile number, and 12-digit Aadhaar Number (or 28-digit Enrolment ID).
Step 4: Fill in personal details, educational qualifications (all subjects aggregate marks), ITI trade details, and choose ONE Division/Workshop carefully.
Step 5: Upload scanned photograph (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 70 KB, 100 DPI) and signature (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 30 KB, 100 DPI).
Step 6: Upload scanned copies of Class 10th marksheet/certificate, ITI marksheet & NTC/provisional certificate, Caste/EWS/Disability certificate (if applicable).
Step 7: Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹100/- online (SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates are exempted).
Step 8: Review all submitted information carefully, submit the application before 15/09/2026 (17:00 hrs), and download/print the finalized application form.

Single Application Rule: Only one application is allowed per trade. Multiple applications for the same trade with varied details will lead to immediate rejection.

faqs.question: Is there any written examination or interview for selection?
faqs.answer: No. There is NO written test, computer-based exam, or interview. Selection is made solely on the basis of academic merit calculated from the aggregate percentage of marks in Matriculation (Class 10th) with a minimum of 50% marks.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification required for ECoR Act Apprentice?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10th) under 10+2 system with minimum 50% aggregate marks from a recognized board, plus possess an ITI Certificate (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in the relevant trade affiliated to NCVT/SCVT. For Medical Lab Tech (Pathology), 12th Pass with PCB (min 50% marks in both 10th & 12th) is required.

faqs.question: Are Diploma or Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) degree holders eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: No. Engineering graduates and Diploma holders are not eligible to apply under this notification as they fall under a separate apprenticeship scheme.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for ECoR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Applicants must be between 15 to 24 years of age as on 15 September 2026 (closing date). Upper age relaxation applies for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per rules.

faqs.question: How much is the application fee and who is exempted?
faqs.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for General/OBC/EWS male candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, and Women applicants of all categories are 100% exempted from paying any fee (₹0).

faqs.question: How is the 10th class percentage calculated for the merit list?
faqs.answer: The percentage is calculated based on the total marks of ALL subjects mentioned in the mark sheet (including optional, additional, and alternate subjects). The 'best of five' calculation is strictly not permitted.

faqs.question: What benefit do Railway Apprentices (CCAA) receive in future Railway jobs?
faqs.answer: Candidates who successfully complete Act Apprenticeship training (CCAA) in Railway establishments and hold National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) will be given preference for up to 20% of vacancies in direct open market Railway Level-1 (Group-D, Pay Scale ₹18,000 – ₹56,900) recruitments.

faqs.question: Can I apply for more than one Division or Workshop under ECoR?
faqs.answer: No. Applicants are permitted to choose only ONE Division or Workshop. The choice once submitted cannot be changed.

faqs.question: Can a candidate possessing ITI in multiple trades apply separately?
faqs.answer: Yes. Applicants possessing ITI qualifications in more than one trade may apply separately for each relevant trade.

faqs.question: Where will the Document Verification (DV) be conducted?
faqs.answer: Document Verification for all shortlisted candidates across all units will take place centrally at the Headquarters of East Coast Railway, Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

faqs.question: What are the photo and signature upload specifications?
faqs.answer: Photograph: Recent colour photo, 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 70 KB, 100 DPI in JPG/JPEG format (taken within 3 months, clear front view without cap/goggles). Signature: 3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20 KB to 30 KB, 100 DPI.

faqs.question: What is the date of issue requirement for OBC-NCL certificate?
faqs.answer: OBC-NCL certificates must be issued on or after 01/04/2026 in the prescribed Central Government format (Annexure 'C') along with a Self-Declaration form (Annexure 'D').

faqs.question: Will hostel accommodation be provided during apprenticeship training?
faqs.answer: No. No hostel accommodation is provided during training. Apprentices must make their own boarding and lodging arrangements.

faqs.question: Does completion of apprenticeship guarantee permanent employment in Railways?
faqs.answer: No. As per the Apprentices Act, 1961, it is not obligatory for Railways to offer permanent employment upon training completion. However, CCAA holders get up to 20% quota/preference in Railway Level-1 direct recruitments.

faqs.question: What is the stipend paid during apprenticeship training?
faqs.answer: Selected apprentices will be paid a monthly stipend at the prescribed rates as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Railway Board directives issued from time to time.

faqs.question: What are the minimum physical standards required?
faqs.answer: Height: minimum 137 cm, Weight: minimum 25.4 kg, Chest expansion: not less than 3.8 cm, Visual Acuity: Bee-One standard (6/9, 6/12 with or without glasses).

faqs.question: What is the official helpline number for online application assistance?
faqs.answer: Candidates facing any issues in online application submission can contact the Help Line Number: 7303484063 or Email: support@ecorbbs.in.
